tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Zec.6.10;
son of: Zephaniah (H6846I); also called Hen at Zec.6.14;
Another name of yo.shiy.yah (יֹאשִׁיָּ֫הוּ "Josiah" H2977H)
§ Hen = "favour"
a contemporary of Zerubbabel

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Chen, a figurative name for an Israelite
